title: Computational Mutagenesis and Inhibition of Staphylococcus aureus AgrA LytTR Domain Using Phenazine Scaffolds: Insight From a Biophysical Study.
authors: Manu, Prince; Nketia, Prisca Baah; Osei-Poku, Priscilla; Kwarteng, Alexander
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接、MD模拟和计算突变分析卤代吩嗪化合物对金黄色葡萄球菌AgrA LytTR域与DNA结合界面的破坏机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非典型TF且偏药物设计。
abstract: Biofilm formation by Staphylococcus aureus is a major challenge in clinical settings due to its role in persistent infections. The AgrA protein, a key regulator in biofilm development, is a promising target for therapeutic intervention. This study investigates the antibiofilm potential of halogenated phenazine compounds by targeting AgrA and explores their molecular interactions to provide insights for drug development. We employed molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and computational mutagenesis to evaluate the binding of halogenated phenazine compounds (C1 to C7, HP, and HP-14) to AgrA. Binding free energy analysis was performed to assess the affinity of these compounds for the AgrA-DNA complex. Additionally, the impact of these compounds on AgrA's structural conformation and salt bridge interactions was examined. The binding-free energy analysis revealed that all compounds enhance binding affinity compared to the Apo form of AgrA, which has a DeltaG(bind) of -80.75 kcal/mol. The strongest binding affinities were observed with compounds C7 (-113.84 kcal/mol), HP-14 (-115.23 kcal/mol), and HP (-112.28 kcal/mol), highlighting their effectiveness. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that these compounds bind at the hydrophobic cleft of AgrA, disrupting essential salt bridge interactions between His174-Glu163 and His174-Glu226. This disruption led to structural conformational changes and reduced DNA binding affinity, aligning with experimental findings on biofilm inhibition. The halogenated phenazine compounds effectively inhibit biofilm formation by targeting AgrA, disrupting its DNA-binding function. The study supports the potential of these compounds as antibiofilm agents and provides a foundation for rational drug design targeting the AgrA-DNA interaction. Future research should focus on further optimizing these lead compounds and exploring additional active sites on AgrA to develop novel treatments for biofilm-associated infections.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜的形成是临床环境中的重大挑战，因其在持续性感染中的作用而备受关注。AgrA蛋白是生物膜发育中的关键调控因子，是治疗干预的有前景靶点。本研究通过靶向AgrA探讨卤化吩嗪化合物的抗生物膜潜力，并探索其分子相互作用，为药物开发提供见解。我们采用分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和计算突变技术，评估卤化吩嗪化合物（C1至C7、HP和HP-14）与AgrA的结合情况。进行了结合自由能分析，以评估这些化合物对AgrA-DNA复合物的亲和力。此外，还考察了这些化合物对AgrA结构构象和盐桥相互作用的影响。结合自由能分析显示，与AgrA的Apo形式（其DeltaG(bind)为-80.75 kcal/mol）相比，所有化合物均增强了结合亲和力。最强的结合亲和力出现在化合物C7（-113.84 kcal/mol）、HP-14（-115.23 kcal/mol）和HP（-112.28 kcal/mol）中，凸显了其有效性。分子动力学模拟表明，这些化合物结合于AgrA的疏水裂隙，破坏了His174-Glu163和His174-Glu226之间的关键盐桥相互作用。这种破坏导致结构构象变化和DNA结合亲和力降低，与生物膜抑制的实验结果一致。卤化吩嗪化合物通过靶向AgrA并破坏其DNA结合功能，有效抑制生物膜形成。本研究支持这些化合物作为抗生物膜剂的潜力，并为靶向AgrA-DNA相互作用的合理药物设计提供了基础。未来研究应侧重于进一步优化这些先导化合物，并探索AgrA上的其他活性位点，以开发针对生物膜相关感染的新型治疗方法。
